'''Locara''' was an individual who objected to Boss [[Gew'lek]]'s hit on the [[Cavalier Club]]. She demanded compensation from him, backing up her demand with a [[Palandrix Personal Protection Gear]] [[power cane]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
